begin_true_means: Arming accepted; may already be Recording if actual PrimaryVolume is positive. It never means accepted sound or verified signal.
required_output_directory: Absolute NEW child of an existing evidence parent, e.g. 原件/audio-v001. Caller must NOT create this child beforehand.
tick: Poll() on game thread. No old ContentProbe in any World; one helper process lease.
movie_origin: Copy Status().StartMonotonic exactly; enable movie screenshots and normal inputs only after Recording, not while Arming.
stop: After last original screenshot callback: disable further movie screenshots, freeze observer game/event/request facts once, Stop() once, then flush screenshot writes. Repeated Stop in ExportPending/Complete returns true without reissue or timestamp reset.
finish_gate: Poll until IsTerminal(). Only Phase Complete is successful export; Failed/Aborted preserve all partial originals and require failure report.
timing_report: capture_timing.capture_start_monotonic_s=Status.StartMonotonic; capture_stop_monotonic_s=Status.StopMonotonic; frame_wall_offsets_s use that exact start and one real callback each.
nested_report: runtime-report.main_submix_capture = SerializeReport(); do not fabricate audiorecorded=true from helper state alone.
cleanup: EndPlay before terminal: Abort(reason). Keep owner/helper alive until async completion; no new capture after active/export failure in same process.
checker_scope: Complete original/canonical PCM identity, independent full WAV decode, old non-silence and100ms/150ms timing gates. No cue identification/listening/device-onset/final mix acceptance.
native_required_future_checks: Normal Arming→Recording→one Stop→async Complete and checker
Repeated Stop cannot reset start/stop or reexport
Existing output leaf fails without changing old bytes
Same-frame abort drains after queued Start; failure prevents process reuse
Mixer/world loss retains failed state without touching foreign main
